nameEn: Manufacture of technical and industrial textiles
description: This class includes the manufacture of textile fabrics and articles intended for technical and industrial use.
includes: manufacture of textile fabrics impregnated, coated, covered or laminated with rubber or plastics
manufacture of tyre cord fabric of high tenacity yarn of nylon, polyester or viscose rayon
manufacture of textile fabrics for reinforcement of mechanical rubber goods
manufacture of industrial textiles including wicks and incandescent gas mantles
manufacture of conveyor or transmission belts or belting of textile material
manufacture of filter fabrics and felt for industrial use
excludes: manufacture of transmission belts of rubber, see 2219
